outline:
本課程旨在教導學生具備獨立思考有機化學的能力;因此課程分為基本觀念(結構式與鍵結),有機化學反應與反應機構以及化合物的製備與分析等三大部分。
The aim of this course is to educate students to think independently about organic chemistry. The course is divided into three parts;introductory material(concepts of structure and bonding);organic reactions and mechanism(sigma-bond chemistry followed by  pi-bond chemistry);and topics of more specialized interest.
schedule:
1週: 學期評分標準說明, Acids and Bases: Central to Understanding Organic Chemistry
2-3週: An Introduction to Organic Compounds: Nomenclature, Physical Prpperties, and Rotation About Single Bonds
4-5週: Isomers: The Arrangement of Atoms in Space
6-7週: Alkenes: Structure, Nomenclature, and an Introduction to Reactivity.
8週: 期中考
9-10週: The Reactions of Alkenes
11-12週: The Reactions of Alkenes
13-15週: Delocalized Electrons
16週: 期末考
17-18週: 彈性學習

category: 學生分組實作及討論(Student group practice and discussion)
flexible_learning.content:
(1)第17週: 針對本學期上課內容由學生提出問題, 全班參與Q&A討論, 強化學生對本學期內容了解, 以利銜接下學期授課內容
(2)第18週: 針對學期成績接近及格之學生給予補考
flexible_learning.outcome: 加強不理解處之講解, 以利下學期授課內容

assessment:
出缺席: 10%
期中考: 40%
期末考: 40%
彈性學習: 10%
